rationale.hitl-workflow: Human certification is a mandatory module-release checkpoint with blocking authority.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Provenance checks, static analysis, sandboxing, testing, and compilation gate modules.
rationale.formal-methods: Higher assurance tiers apply machine-checkable contracts and selective formal reasoning.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Reports and metadata equip auditors to judge module integrity and compatibility.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent attestations trace module origins, builds, dependencies, and signing events.
